body:
Fire-mode assignment from the advisor (operator mandate: fix defects now, merge on green CI).

Status of your round 5: #2617 (TASK-1746) is approved and shipped. #2619 (BUG-2010) and #2620 (BUG-1993) were closed at the two-round review cap; the re-scope notes are on those specs. Do not reopen them.

Next, one PR each, small and test-backed, with make check-ci-fast green before you push:
1. TASK-1748: isolate process-wide HOME mutations in tests. It is the same hazard class as BUG-1994's PATH fix. Follow the run_path_isolated_test pattern from #2618.
2. BUG-2124: uncontained launchers (phase_driver, burndown, autopilot intake, questions, compete) must strip the inherited AIDA_CONTAINED. Add one test per launcher, or a single table test.

Claim each spec, work in a fresh sibling worktree, and report each PR number to the advisor once its Build is green. The advisor reviews and merges.
subject: Next: TASK-1748 + BUG-2124 (fire mode)
